readOnly.PUBLISHED: This internship is published, so its details can no longer be edited. Pause or close it first if something needs to change.
readOnly.PAUSED: This internship is paused. Published internships cannot be edited — close it and create a new one if the details need to change.
readOnly.CLOSED: This internship is closed. Closed internships cannot be edited.
readOnly.CANCELLED: This internship was cancelled. Cancelled internships cannot be edited.
